name: How do I choose the right contractor for my interior renovation?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my interior renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor, look for experience, strong communication, and a clear understanding of your project vision. Verify their licensing and insurance. Review their portfolio of past work and ask for client references. A reputable contractor will provide a detailed proposal outlining scope, timeline, and cost. Trust your comfort level with their team and their ability to address your questions effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor based on experience, communication, licensing, insurance, and client references. Ensure they provide a detailed proposal.
